source: Recorded pilot run multihop_a9aff89630 (audited report v3.0.1). Read-only copy; no experiment was re-run.
design: 3 practice questions; 6 held-out questions per condition; 1 repetition; fresh sessions; frozen memory.

metacognitive_lesson.trigger: when a dict lookup by file path raises KeyError after building the dict with glob
metacognitive_lesson.lesson: Glob on Windows returns keys with backslash separators; looking up paths written with forward slashes (or any guessed separator) fails. This error recurred across runs and cost repeated failed calls. On a KeyError, immediately print or filter the actual dict keys (e.g., match on the artifact number) to recover the exact key format instead of retrying with a different guessed path string.

caveats: Small pilot; one repetition per condition.
Lower tool calls = more efficient; not a correctness measure.
All numeric answers correct; 'both' lost one evidence-valid task to a citation-compliance failure.
